observations: Photo 0 shows a full-size electronic keyboard with a purple control panel and a small display area; brand text appears on the panel.
Photo 1 shows the front of the keyboard with large 'YAMAHA' branding on the body.
Photo 2 shows the keyboard from a different angle; 'YAMAHA' branding is visible again, and the keys/control panel are present.
No model number or exact series name is readable in the provided photos.

claims.evidence: Yamaha branding is visible on photo 1 and photo 2.
Photos show 'YAMAHA' branding on photo 1 and photo 2, not Casio.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model/series is not readable, so the price could be wrong (different models vary a lot in value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label/sticker (usually on the back or underside) showing the full model name/number.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic used Yamaha keyboard with unknown model (worst-case value for an older/entry model).

risks.risk: Functionality is unverified (keys, speakers, display, power, and sound may be faulty).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, working display, playing several keys, and volume/speaker output (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully tested / possibly not working (worst-case for resale).

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition may hide damage (scratches, broken knobs/buttons, missing keys, or loose casing).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the control knobs/buttons area and both ends of the keyboard, plus a photo of any visible cracks/loose parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming normal wear plus potential minor cosmetic issues (worst-case within typical used condition).

risks.risk: Seller text conflicts with photos (Casio claim vs Yamaha branding), which can indicate careless listing or higher scam risk.
risks.proof: Ask for the same model label photo and a receipt/serial photo (or a photo of the back panel with serial/model).
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively due to mismatch risk until identity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the back/underside model label (full model number/series + serial).
Video: power-on + display working + playing keys + changing a sound/voice + volume control.
Close-ups: control panel buttons/knobs and both sides/ends for any missing/broken parts.
Photo of power adapter/charging/power input (and confirmation of included accessories).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model is not readable and the seller’s text conflicts (Casio vs Yamaha). Without the model label and a quick functionality check, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
